children: The Bank of England could keep interest rates unchanged at 3.75% for the remainder of 2026 given the U.K.'s fragile jobs market, ING economists say in a note. The current bank rate is restrictive already, which lowers the need for urgent BOE interest-rate increases, the economists say. "Unlike the U.S. or even the eurozone, where there is a live debate about whether monetary policy is restricting activity at the current level of interest rates, that is a much harder argument to make in Britain." Markets fully price in three BOE rate rises by March 2027, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
